schedule.description: Cron expression (e.g. '0 9 * * *') or ISO timestamp for one-shot (e.g. '2026-04-18T09:00:00Z')

prompt.description: Task instruction for the agent to execute when the job fires

job_id.description: Stable job ID for list_runs or bind actions

read_id.description: Opaque token from a prior list/get operation, required for pre_delete/delete/pause/resume actions. Also accepted by bind for backward compatibility, but prefer job_id. For delete, use the read_id returned by pre_delete (it is frozen and won't expire).

name.description: Optional human-friendly name for the job

model.description: Optional model override for job execution

limit.description: Max number of run records to return (for list_runs, default 20)
